setting.name: Spirits of Manhattan
setting.tagline: Blue-collar ghost hunters with particle throwers in 1984 New York
setting.blurb: Remember 1984? It was the time when a gate to a hell dimension nearly opened up in the middle of New York, unleashing undead horrors upon the world. Thankfully, a team of dedicated, if reluctant, specialists with incredibly dangerous equipment risked everything to save the city - the Ghostbreakers! The Heroes are paranormal exterminators who blast, bind and contain restless spirits, rack up collateral damage, and try to keep the ghost-rights group PURE (Protection of Undead Returned Entities) off their backs. There will be scares, there will be laughs, and a lot of the science won't add up - but it's all part of the fun.
rules: Roles: Heroes should be blue-collar workers or academics; any Role from the core Occupations list is allowed with the Director's permission.

Anti-plasm particle throwers affect incorporeal (and corporeal) creatures fully, doing 2 damage on a hit. When an incorporeal creature is reduced to 0 Health it is defeated and ready to be transported back to the containment field at HQ.

Collateral Damage: when the wielder misses with an anti-plasm beam, collateral damage always occurs. Track the damage as normal and multiply it by 100 - that is the dollar damage accrued. Have the property owner sign a damage waiver first.

Anti-Plasm Binders keep a weakened ghost in its trapped state by applying a charge of 'hit' at regular intervals; without them a spirit defeated by repeated blasts eventually recovers and resumes haunting.

EMF Class: every ghost has an EMF Class equal to its Power Stat, readable on an EMF detector. Class I is a nuisance, Class VIII or more is very dangerous, Class X or higher is terrifyingly powerful (demons, demigods).
Ghostly Property - Incorporeal: spirits pass through solid objects and are immune to all damage except anti-plasm and holy damage (holy water, some magical spells, blessed weapons).

Ghostly Property - Immortal: spirits cannot be killed. Reduced to 0 Health or below (by anti-plasm) they can be captured. A ghost's Health recovers 1 point per round automatically, and once above zero it starts moving again.
Ghostly Property - Flight: spirits can freely fly, although many are locked into old habits and do not.
Demonic Property - Immortal: demons cannot be killed. Reduced to 0 Health (by anti-plasm, silver, or holy weapons) they are banished from the world for 99 years.
Demonic Property - Realms of Fire: demons are immune to fire.

Demonic Property - Corporeal: demons can be hit (and hit back) but are immune to ballistic damage and to any weapon that does not do holy damage or is not made of silver. Holy water causes them 1 damage per dose; anti-plasm affects them fully.

Ghostly Glossary (combine with EMF Class, e.g. 'Class VII free-roaming apparition'): Apparition (looks like a living creature), Demon (corporeal entity from another plane), Echo (temperature change or sound only), Focused (tied to a location), Free-roaming (not tied), Full Torso (entire body), Partial (voice, hands...), Repeating (appears at set times), Specific (ghost of a known individual), Vapor (blob with no distinct form).

Run Some Red Lights: on urgent drives roll a die for a complication - 1 Roadworks (Smarts 10), 2 Flatbed (Moves 10), 3 Glass (Smarts 10 to spot), 4 Fruit Cart (Moves 10 to smash through or 15 to swerve), 5 Wetworks (Smarts 10 to reroute or Moves 15 to gun it), 6 Nuns! (Moves 15).

Spectral vehicles: a ghostly vehicle is part of the apparition (e.g. Defence 15, Health 8); blast it to pieces with anti-plasm to leave the ghost itself catchable. The driver makes Moves checks to dodge obstacles and close the gap.

Ghosts haunt because of unresolved business; resolve it and they move on. Only spirits with inherently evil motivations are exiled to a hell dimension - PURE will check that captured ghosts are treated well.

roles.name: Demonologist
roles.ability: You know how to hurt demons. You do an extra point of damage whenever you successfully attack a demon.

roles.name: Exorcist
roles.ability: By chanting prayers and holding forth the symbol of your faith, you can make a Style attack against a ghost or demon’s Defence, and if you are successful you do 1 point of damage to them and they cannot approach you for one minute.

gear.name: "Spirit Stopper" Anti-Plasm Particle Thrower
gear.description: Heavyweight backpack housing a miniature particle collider that fires a stream of anti-plasm particles. Affects incorporeal (and corporeal) creatures fully, doing 2 damage on a hit; an incorporeal creature at zero Health is defeated and ready for containment. Unwieldy, inaccurate and often held together with duct tape - every miss causes collateral damage (damage x $100).

gear.name: Anti-Plasm Binders
gear.description: Once a ghost has become weak enough, Anti-Plasm Binders keep the entity in its trapped state, applying a charge of 'hit' at regular intervals and keeping the entity (hopefully) immobilized.

gear.name: ElectroMagnetic Field (EMF) Detector
gear.description: Detects spirits, specters and ghosts by changes in the electromagnetic fields around us - lights flash and alarms sound. Also reads the ghost's EMF Class (its Power Stat).

gear.name: Ghostmobile
gear.description: A disused Range Rover Popemobile, originally made for the British visit of Pope John Paul II in 1982. The reinforced glass rear is covered in warding and binding symbols and Anti-Plasm nodes to keep a ghost trapped.

gear.name: Spirit-Spectacles Goggles
gear.description: Allow the wearer to see incorporeal spirits before they have fully visually materialized, and show the percentage of 'Health' remaining in a non-corporeal entity.

gear.name: Holy Water
gear.description: Provides holy damage: one of the few things that hurts incorporeal spirits, and causes demons 1 damage per dose.

extras.name: Demonkin
notes: Demonkin possess the qualities noted in 'Demonic Properties'.
extras.description: Minor demonic minions and servants.

extras.name: Firemage
extras.description: Flame throwing sorcerers!

extras.name: Ghostly Creep
notes: The Ghostly Creep can turn invisible at-will.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: Sneaky ghost which likes to haunt people.

extras.name: Gozarr the Devourer
notes: Gozarr possesses the qualities noted in 'Demonic Properties'.
Roar as a Power attack vs Style; causes those affected to run away.
Quake is a Power attack vs. Moves to all nearby; 1 damage and knocked down.
extras.description: Immensely powerful godlike demon from another dimension.

extras.name: Grim Reaper
notes: The Grim Reaper possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
When the Grim Reaper reduces a target to 0 Health, it dies instantly. Scary!
extras.description: A dark hooded figure with a wicked scythe.

extras.name: Napolitano Brothers
notes: The Napolitano Brothers possess the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: A pair of floating ghosts strapped into electric chairs.

extras.name: Phantasmal Drake
notes: The Phantasmal Drake possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: A large phantasmal dragon.

extras.name: Phantasmal Horror
notes: The Phantasmal Horror possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: A placid looking ghost which suddenly reveals its horrific nature.

extras.name: Shrieker
notes: Shriekers possess the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: A nasty little spirit with a big voice.

extras.name: Slime Bucket
notes: The Slime Bucket possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: A nasty little spirit with a big voice (as printed).

extras.name: Terror Dog
notes: Terror Dogs possess the qualities noted in 'Demonic Properties'.
extras.description: Demonic hellhounds which serve evil powers.

extras.name: Trickster Spirit
notes: Tricksters possess the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Tricksters can teleport to a location they can see nearby.
Tricksters can make Power vs. Style checks to make a target charmed or angry.
extras.description: Cunning and manipulative ghosts.

extras.name: Emeline Holt

attacks.name: Shriek
attacks.note: 1 damage to everybody nearby; her scream can shatter glass

notes: Uses the stats of a Shrieker.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Harmless once trapped; a one-in-a-million glitch leaves her semi-corporeal and she offers to be the Ghostbreakers' receptionist.
extras.description: The ghost of a woman in 19th-century clothing haunting St. Peter's Chapel, still pining for her Edward who died over 200 years ago.

extras.name: Magoozer
notes: Uses the stats of a Phantasmal Horror.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Not violent unless disturbed: first a 'Shuuush', then red glowing eyes and a snarl, third time it transforms into a giant tentacle-faced nasty hurling books and ectoplasm.
A minion of Gozarr that lies constantly; in the finale it may already be injured at the Director's option.
extras.description: Looks like a wizened old man about three feet tall with ridiculously oversized spectacles, shuffling through the library stacks in search of Zephron's Guide.

extras.name: Will Mapleton

attacks.name: Flashbulb
attacks.note: no damage; victim is blinded for one minute

notes: Has the stats of a Ghostly Creep, but instead of its invisibility ability it has a Flashbulb attack.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Flees through walls and sinks through floors when attacked.
extras.description: The ghost of a sleazy tabloid photographer who fell from the 14th floor of the Glitzman Hotel; only appears when romance is in the offing.

extras.name: Stella Henderson

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.note: throws Heroes about, coils firehoses like snakes, fires jets of high pressure water

notes: Uses the stats of a Trickster Spirit.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Can teleport to a location she can see nearby; can make Power vs. Style checks to make a target charmed or angry.
Will not attack unless the firefighters are put at risk, and will never try to kill the Ghostbreakers.
extras.description: Ghost of the chief of Engine 30 Fire Station, lost in a 1982 auto-shop blaze; now keeps her crew locked inside 'for their own safety'.

extras.name: Jess Hardacre

attacks.name: Shriek
attacks.note: sonic attack; 1 damage to everybody nearby

notes: Uses the stats of a Shrieker.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Not really a danger to the Heroes; a simple bag and tag.
extras.description: A drummer who exploded trying out pyrotechnics on his kit, now performing epic ten-minute drum solos over other bands at Heebie-Jeebies.

extras.name: Spectral Taxi
notes: The cab is part of the ghostly apparition; the driver must make Moves checks to dodge obstacles and close the gap before passengers can open fire.
At zero Health it crumbles to pieces, leaving the dazed cabbie Elroy McHale in the street ready to be captured.
Passes through traffic as a ghost would through walls; appears at 11:57pm speeding the length of Broadway.
extras.description: A yellow cab glowing with spectral light, careening through traffic at high speed with its ghostly driver at the wheel.

extras.name: Elroy McHale
notes: Uses the stats of a Phantasmal Horror.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Only catchable after his Spectral Taxi has been blasted to pieces.
extras.description: Ghostly cabbie who crashed and died speeding to a pick-up and is still determined to get his passengers there on time.

extras.name: Patzarr (Patrick Dickens possessed by Gozarr)

attacks.name: Firebolt
attacks.note: 30' range; blasts of green fire from his hands

notes: Uses the stats of a Firemage - only a fragment of Gozarr possesses him.
When weakening he can shoot fireballs at the three possessed hosts to sever their ties.
A few blasts take him down; an exorcism (holy water and a couple of bible passages) then removes Gozarr's presence.
extras.description: Nerdy business student Patrick Dickens as the living receptacle for Gozarr the Devourer, hair standing on end and suit glowing with energy.

extras.name: Callor The Keeper
notes: Uses the stats of a Phantasmal Horror once freed from inhabiting Gillian Templemere.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: Guardian of the portal, an ever vigilant sentry from the Nether that took up residence in the head librarian.

extras.name: Liril The Purifier
notes: Uses the stats of a Trickster Spirit once freed from inhabiting Emily Waterhouse.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
Can teleport to a location it can see nearby; Power vs. Style checks to make a target charmed or angry.
extras.description: A violent and vengeful entity that thrives off the destruction of those unworthy to serve or feed Gozarr the Devourer.

extras.name: Unthag The Servant
notes: Uses the stats of a Shrieker once freed from inhabiting Dean Richard Anderson.
Possesses the qualities noted in 'Ghostly Properties'.
extras.description: Gozarr's second in command and weasley little suck-up, who lives to bring his master through to our realm.

extras.name: Giant Gozarr Manifestation
notes: Stats are identical to Gozarr the Devourer whatever form it takes; only the appearance differs.
Roar as a Power attack vs Style (those affected run away); Quake is a Power attack vs. Moves to all nearby, 1 damage and knocked down.

The Ghostbreakers will not stand a chance in a stand-up fight. The only way to defeat it is to reverse the portal: flick the switch on the particle throwers to fire pure antimatter and make a normal roll to hit the portal, creating a miniature black hole.
extras.description: Gozarr manifests as a 100ft tall version of whatever the Heroes think of (Edgar Allan Poe by default), striding through the city towards the library.
